title: Never-Before-Released Photos of Madonna Comes Out in Celebration of Her 68th Birthday: Shop the Prints
summary: Sonic Editions drops 17 high-quality prints of the "Material Girl."
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

To celebrate her 68th birthday on Aug. 16, Madonna is getting 17 prints from limited-edition photography company Sonic Editions , with the collection spanning several decades of her legendary career. Most of the rare images of Madonna capture her early years in the 1980s, offering a look at the era that helped establish her as a pop culture icon. The selection includes candid moments, vintage photoshoots and an appearance alongside the late George Harrison.

All prints come with either a black or white frame and include five size options with varying prices depending on the size. Shoppers can order the 11×14 inches at $189, 16×20 inches at $299, 20×24 inches at $399, 22×30 inches at $699 and 26×37 inches at $999. There is also the option to purchase the print-only copy, which starts at $99.

Each Madonna print is made to order and finished by hand with solid-wood framing, gallery-grade Perspex, and archival Fuji Crystal Archive paper. Acid-free mounting ensures lasting quality, while professional hanging hardware makes installation simple. Each edition is individually numbered and accompanied by the story behind the photograph, making it a distinctive collectible to mark Madonna’s 68th birthday.

Madonna has never been one to keep her birthday celebrations low-key. For her 67th birthday in 2025 , she traveled to Siena, Italy, while her 66th in 2024 included a trip to Rome and a lavish celebration. She marked 65 with a lively birthday bash in Lisbon , Portugal, where her six children danced to “Vogue,” and celebrated turning 64 with a sprawling outdoor party in Sicily, Italy. Besides the limited-edition prints, time will tell what the queen of pop ‘s 68th birthday celebration will bring.

Sonic Editions is a destination for curated fine-art photography, with a mission to make exceptional imagery feel timeless and accessible. For more than 15 years, the company has searched for rare and striking photographs to add to its continually refreshed archive. Its gallery-quality prints are carefully produced as limited editions, offering collectors pieces of cultural history. Its collection includes photographs of Aretha Franklin , Dolly Parton , Oasis , The Beatles and much more.
